new_value: {"notes":"Implemented allocation-free Zephyr tunnel authorization root/egress module. Root route-installed adapter emits OSCORE-required POST to /.well-known/tunnel-auth with canonical application/cose COSE_Sign1; manual deterministic CBOR encodes alg -65537 exactly and uses production Schnorr48 over RFC 9052 Sig_structure SHA-256. Egress verifies OSCORE sender, root key/IID, signature, route hash, egress, expiry, monotonic per-prefix/route sequence floors, revocation/root rotation/clock rollback, bounded LRU authorization cache and fail-closed history capacity. Data-plane check enforces mesh-to-external direction, exact route, longest prefix, IPv6 source/destination scope before external publication. Crypto is callback-injected for deterministic host testing and default-wired to TinyCrypt+Monocypher on Zephyr; no allocation. Canonical fixture generator consumes test/vectors/tunnel_authorization.json. Validation: strict C11 compile -Wall/-Wextra/-Werror/-Wconversion/-Wshadow; cppcheck clean; host C23 UBSan test 1/1 pass including exact Python/Rust wire parity, malformed/noncanonical/trailing, signature/root/egress/OSCORE failures, replay/revoke/fresh grant/rotation/clock rollback, policy, atomic small-buffer output and POST delivery errors; local Zephyr 4.1 qemu_x86 build pass and runtime 2/2 pass, PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL. Shared paths collision-checked; no active overlap."}
